rich2021Text: Original IM2021 G5 U06:L05 uses multi-step metric length conversion and decimal addition/subtraction, with the same distance expressed in centimeters, meters or kilometers. Source situational choices of sensible display units are open teacher-scored decisions.
Warm-up source T/F5423×10=50423 FALSE (54230),5423÷10=542.3 TRUE,5423÷100=54.23 TRUE. Teacher reviews why multiplying by10 changes digits' place values.

Activity1 Walk All Day: Lin's watch assumes EACH STEP 50cm and original events: 5 steps to friend's desk=250cm=2.5m;12 steps to classroom front=600cm=6m;250 steps to bus=12500cm=125m;1000 steps twice around playground=50000cm=500m. Her original daily8500 steps correspond425000cm=4250m=4.25km. Source asks which units are appropriate for those contexts, rather than a single fixed choice.

Activity2 Who Ran Farther? Original Tyler km Monday8.5 Tuesday6.25 Wednesday10.3 Thursday5.75 Friday9.25 =>40.05km. Clare original meters 5400+7500+8250+6750+7250=35150m=35.15km. Tyler ran4.90km farther. Different unit choice must not alter the physical distance; learner explains additive strategies.
